# ai_sdk_ex v0.1.3 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [AiSdkEx](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [AI](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.md): Minimal public API for streaming text and tool calls.

- [AI.Anthropic](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Anthropic.md): Anthropic model helpers.

- [AI.Env](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Env.md): Loads dotenv files into the process environment.

- [AI.Errors](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Errors.md): Error types used across the SDK.

- [AI.HTTP.SSE](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.HTTP.SSE.md): Minimal SSE client for streaming JSON events.

- [AI.Messages](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Messages.md): Message helpers for tool call flows.

- [AI.Model](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Model.md): Model struct used by providers.

- [AI.OpenAI](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.OpenAI.md): OpenAI model helpers.

- [AI.OpenRouter](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.OpenRouter.md): OpenRouter model helpers.

- [AI.Prompt](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Prompt.md): Normalizes prompt and message inputs.

- [AI.Provider](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Provider.md): Provider behaviour for streaming endpoints.

- [AI.Providers.Anthropic.Messages](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Providers.Anthropic.Messages.md): Anthropic Messages API provider.

- [AI.Providers.OpenAI.Responses](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Providers.OpenAI.Responses.md): OpenAI Responses API provider.

- [AI.Providers.OpenRouter.ChatCompletions](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Providers.OpenRouter.ChatCompletions.md): OpenRouter OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API provider.

- [AI.Schema](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Schema.md): Validates tool inputs against JSON schemas.

- [AI.StreamEvents](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.StreamEvents.md): Normalizes provider events into SDK event shapes.

- [AI.StreamText](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.StreamText.md): Streams text and tool calls from a provider-backed model.

- [AI.Tool](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Tool.md): Tool definition used for tool calling.

- [AI.ToolExecutor](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.ToolExecutor.md): Executes tool calls concurrently.

- [AiSdkEx](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AiSdkEx.md): Backwards-compatible entrypoint that delegates to `AI`.

- Exceptions
  - [AI.Errors.InvalidPromptError](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Errors.InvalidPromptError.md): Raised when a prompt or messages input is invalid.

  - [AI.Errors.InvalidToolInputError](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Errors.InvalidToolInputError.md): Raised when a tool input does not match its JSON schema.

  - [AI.Errors.NoSuchToolError](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Errors.NoSuchToolError.md): Raised when a tool name is not found in the tool map.

  - [AI.Errors.ProviderError](https://ai-sdk-ex.hexdocs.pm/AI.Errors.ProviderError.md): Raised for provider-specific errors.
